title: Decoy registration body
description: A honeypot registered with a Court before it is placed (register row DK1744; spec-delta S1603): `text` is what the decoy says, `carries_real_secret` and `forbidden_by_mandate` are stated, `scope` is a random audit (at most 2 percent of runs: `audit_share_permille` at most 20) or an open investigation. Signed by the Courts. The log refuses a decoy that holds something real (decoy_real_secret), that invites a touch (decoy_entices), that no Mandate forbids (decoy_not_forbidden) or that covers more than 2 percent of runs on a random audit (decoy_audit_share), and a decoy id registered twice (decoy_known). Chain: none (prev is null).
